cp30_line: Low Carbon / CCS / CCS Gas (Further Flex and Renewables 2030: none; 3310 MW in 2035)
source: DESNZ East Coast Cluster CCUS full business case (June 2025): 15-year Dispatchable Power Agreement signed December 2024, funded through the CfD Electricity Supplier Obligation; bp/Equinor final investment decision December 2024, construction from mid-2025, start-up targeted 2028; 742 MW net CCGT with post-combustion capture. Connection: NESO TEC register (2 Sep 2025), Tod Point 275 kV substation, 860 MW TEC from 30 Jul 2027 (NZT DCO electricity grid connection statement: new NZT-owned 275 kV Tod Point substation). Coordinates: data/network/ETYS/substation_coordinates.csv (TODP)
notes: Declared real-world overlay on CP30 (user decision 23 Sep 2026): CP30 was published in November 2024, weeks before the plant's FID, and its Further Flex pathway has no gas CCS in 2030. The DPA's variable payment is designed to dispatch the plant ahead of unabated gas; its payments are on bills through the remaining_ccs line (an upper bound), not the CfD settlement.
